thesis: Library of Alexandria converted a land drop into repeatable card advantage whenever its controller could preserve seven cards, redefining how powerful a utility land could be.

competitiveTimeline.significance: From The Deck and early control mirrors to Vintage and Old School, Library became both a strategic engine and a policy landmark because a mana-producing card could also dominate long games.

playbook.role: Build and sequence around the seven-card threshold. Activate before spending a card when possible, use instant-speed interaction to keep options open, and avoid playing extra lands merely from habit.
